subject: Post-demo economics: confirmed budget band & temporary credit commitment
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@elarahealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@elarahealth.com
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo earlier today — quick follow-up on budget

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning, Logan — product team liked the streaming latency numbers and the KV caching behavior for our clinical summarization workflow. Two follow-ups from our side: 1) can you confirm the expected token burn for our baseline ingestion (est. 6k clinical notes / day, avg 450 tokens/note), and 2) we need a short-term cushion (trial/top-up) while procurement completes the PO.

Quick numbers we pulled: 6,000 * 450 = 2.7M tokens/day, ~81M tokens/month. That’s larger than we expected; we’re trying to map it back to a target $/1M tokens. Our internal target is roughly $700–$1,000 per 1M tokens depending on latency SLAs. Can you sketch the unit economics for the MTL-7B quantized profile you demoed? Also please confirm what a modest temporary credit looks like for a 3-week pilot while procurement finalizes terms.

Thanks — Priya
Sr. Product Manager, Elara Health

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@elarahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo earlier today — quick follow-up on budget

Hi Priya — great to hear the product team liked the latency profile. Quick recap and numbers below, plus a proposed temporary credit path while procurement finishes the PO. I’m copying Marissa (sales lead) and Aditya (finops) to confirm internal approval steps.

Summary of expected burn (baseline):
- Notes/day: 6,000
- Avg tokens/note: 450
- Daily tokens: 2,700,000 (~2.7M)
- Monthly tokens (30d): ~81M

Recommended serving profile: MTL-7B quantized (approx same perf as demo)
Estimated unit economics (list price examples):
- On-hosted Redwood API, MTL-7B q4f: $850 per 1M tokens (generation + context combined)
- With autoscaling and KV cache expected to reduce billable tokens by ~15% over steady-state for your access patterns (prefix caching of templates + patient metadata) — effective $/1M closer to $730 if caching is realized

Cost scenarios for a 3-week pilot (21 days):
- No-cache conservative: 2.7M/day * 21 = 56.7M tokens -> list cost = 56.7 * $0.85 = $48,195
- Realistic with caching (15%): billable 48.195M tokens -> effective cost ~ $40,400

Proposed temporary credit / top-up (our suggestion to keep pilot running while procurement processes):
- Option A (full safety net): one-time credit of $48,000 (covers conservative estimate)
- Option B (partial cushion): one-time credit of $25,000 (covers ~60% of conservative; expect you to bank on caching offsets)
- Option C (token-limited): 50M token credit (redeemable only for MTL-7B q4f), equivalent to ~ $42,500 at list

Ask from your side: please confirm which option looks best from a procurement standpoint and whether we should route a provisional credit agreement (simple credit memo) so we can enable top-up immediately.

Attaching a quick usage snapshot and the demo deck. If helpful I can also share a short cost-model workbook breaking down hourly burn by batch window.

Next internal step: Marissa / Aditya — can you confirm what we can commit today without a signed PO? I’m recommending Option B ($25k) to avoid an overcommit while still keeping the pilot healthy.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: elara_demo-deck.pdf; elara_usage-snapshot.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-16T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo earlier today — quick follow-up on budget

On Mon, Aug 16, 2027 at 11:05 AM Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
> 
> Next internal step: Marissa / Aditya — can you confirm what we can commit today without a signed PO? I’m recommending Option B ($25k) to avoid an overcommit while still keeping the pilot healthy.
> 
Hi team — I reviewed the numbers and the deal record (ELR-2027-042). Given the account profile (healthcare, potential Dedicated later), I approve a provisional credit of up to $20,000 today with the following guardrails:
- Credit is one-time, expires after 30 days if unused.
- Credit is token-limited to the MTL-7B q4f SKU or equivalent variants we’ve agreed with the Solutions engineer; non-transferable.
- Procurement must provide a PO within 21 days; if PO not received we limit future top-ups and schedule a usage review.

Aditya — please issue a credit memo (internal ticket FIN-CC-872) and flag billing to monitor daily burn for Elara. We should set an alert at 60% consumption of that credit.

Logan — please confirm to Priya and the procurement address; include the credit memo number once FIN creates it. Keep me in the loop for any escalation.

Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@elarahealth.com>, procurement@elarahealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-18T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo earlier today — quick follow-up on budget

Priya — quick update and confirmation: Marissa approved a one-time provisional credit of $20,000 under the guardrails below. Our finance team will issue a credit memo (FIN-CC-872) and I’ll paste the memo/link once it’s live.

Recap of the path forward:
- Provisional credit: $20,000 (applies to MTL-7B q4f SKU only; expires in 30 days)
- Procurement ask: please send the formal PO within 21 days so we can transition to a committed billing arrangement and avoid service interruptions.
- Monitoring: we will enable an alert at 60% consumption of the credit and report weekly usage snapshots during the pilot.

Priya, does that work on your end? If yes I’ll enable the credit and confirm the memo id. If you prefer a token-denominated option (50M tokens), we can convert — that would map to about $42,500 at list, but given the credit approval size the token option would be partial.

Thanks everyone — will follow up with the FIN ticket link.

Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
